svg.title: Hashim 2025
svg.desc: Isometric contribution terrain for @Hashim1999164 from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. 1,443 contributions across 365 active days. 2 wonders discovered. relative normalization, maximum 10.

g.aria-label: Contribution height legend. Relative P90 scale from 0 to 10 contributions. Five palette bins from low to high.

rect.aria-label: Empty contribution height; representative elevation 0 of 99
Low contribution height; representative elevation 20 of 99
Mid contribution height; representative elevation 45 of 99
High contribution height; representative elevation 70 of 99
Max contribution height; representative elevation 99 of 99

g.aria-label: Calendar timeline from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Month and season cues follow supplied contribution dates.

svg.text: Water and trees are scenery, not contributions
